name: Whiteheads
description: Whiteheads are a type of acne that appears as small, white bumps on the skin. They form when the hair follicles become clogged with sebum (oil), dead skin cells, and bacteria, but remain closed beneath the skin surface.
symptoms: Small, white bumps on the skin
May appear on the face, chest, or back
Do not contain pus and do not protrude from the skin surface

daily_routine.purpose: Remove dirt and excess oil from the skin
Gently remove dead skin cells to prevent clogs
Keep the skin hydrated without clogging pores

common_myths: Whiteheads are caused by dirt on the skin.
Picking at whiteheads can help them go away faster.
when_to_consult_doctor: If whiteheads persist despite home care or worsen in severity, consult a dermatologist.

severity_levels.mild: A few scattered whiteheads on the skin that do not cause significant discomfort or irritation.
severity_levels.moderate: Several whiteheads present, occasionally accompanied by mild redness and tenderness.
severity_levels.severe: A high number of whiteheads covering large areas of the skin, leading to potential scarring if left untreated.

expert_tips: Avoid touching or squeezing whiteheads as it can lead to inflammation and scarring.
Regularly change pillowcases and towels to prevent bacteria buildup.
Consult a dermatologist for personalized treatment plans.
